now.title: Doctor Strange
now.text: Christine helps Strange recover, then saves his life when he is stabbed in astral form.

proposed.text: Christine helps Strange after his crash, then operates to save his life when a zealot stabs him, while his astral form fights on.

changes.evidence: Strange is stabbed in the back by the zealot Lucian in his physical body at the New York Sanctum, then portals to the hospital where Christine operates on him while his astral form duels Lucian; he is not stabbed in astral form.

now.title: Avengers: Endgame
now.text: In 2012, the Ancient One gives Bruce her Time Stone. Steve later travels back to return it.

changes.evidence: This Avengers: Endgame record (the 2012 Time Heist) sits after the Multiverse of Madness record. Story order puts it with the other Endgame record (k5), before Spider-Man: No Way Home (k6), so the file ends on MoM's 'In use'.

now.title: Echo
now.text: In episode 3, Skully gives Maya a new prosthetic leg and tells her that Chafa was the first Choctaw.

proposed.text: In episode 3, Skully gives Maya the new prosthetic leg he promised after patching her broken one, when he told her that Chafa was the first Choctaw.

changes.evidence: Skully patches Maya's broken prosthetic and tells her about the Chafa sculpture, the first Choctaw, in episode 2 (Lowak); he delivers the brand-new leg at the Battiest home in episode 3 (Tuklo). The record has both happening at once in episode 3.

now.title: Avengers: Infinity War
now.text: On Ebony Maw's ship, it slips free to help rescue Strange, and later turns to dust with him in the Snap.

proposed.text: It follows Strange aboard Ebony Maw's ship and helps Tony and Peter rescue him, and later turns to dust with him in the Snap.

changes.evidence: Maw pins the Cloak in New York stoplights; it breaks loose and flies after Strange into the Q-Ship, where it finds Tony and Peter and helps them rescue him. It is never held on the ship, so it does not 'slip free' there.

now.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
now.text: Following Dogpool into Wade's world, he warns them of the Deadpool variants, and Wade uses him as a shield until he is killed.

proposed.text: Arriving in Wade's world with the Deadpool variants, he chases Dogpool to Wade and Logan and warns them of the variants, and Wade uses him as a shield until he is killed.

changes.evidence: Nicepool comes to Earth-10005 together with the Deadpool Corps; once there, Dogpool runs off to Wade and Logan and he follows her. He does not follow Dogpool into Wade's world.

now.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
now.text: Gargantos chases America Chavez through New York until Strange and Wong kill it.
cases: ST-092 The Gargantos Attack (Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness)

proposed.text: Gargantos chases America Chavez through New York until Strange, fighting beside Wong, kills it with a lamppost through its eye.

changes.evidence: Wong helps fight Gargantos but is dropped to the ground; Strange alone kills it, using a spell to drive a light pole into its eye.
